tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground of every screen. Paper grain sits on it.

tokens.name: paper-light
tokens.usage: Deckle (torn) edge of layers; text and lit lamp faces on dark grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text on paper and light layers; nav plate; lines.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Kicker lines, back links, secondary text on paper (6.6:1).

tokens.name: button-face
tokens.usage: Primary capsule button face, always with ink text.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Skill cards and other tappable surfaces on paper; always with shadow-card.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a progress bar on a light card.

tokens.name: layer-1
tokens.usage: Top torn layer / first section band.

tokens.name: layer-2
tokens.usage: Second section band; ink text only (muted text fails here).

tokens.name: layer-3
tokens.usage: Mid stratum; inactive nav label on the dark plate (4.9:1).

tokens.name: layer-4
tokens.usage: Deep stratum; paper-light text on it.

tokens.name: layer-5
tokens.usage: Deep stratum, stage ground, screen windows; paper text on it.

tokens.name: layer-6
tokens.usage: Deepest stratum and the bottom of the nav plate.

tokens.name: dust
tokens.usage: Shadows cast by figures, under-sheet of torn paper.

tokens.name: pellet
tokens.usage: THE red. One meaning per frame: the pellet, the red circle the man stands on, the primary 'دانه' action, skill-done dot.

tokens.name: pellet-hot
tokens.usage: Active tab glyph on the dark nav plate only.

tokens.name: pellet-deep
tokens.usage: Logo dot; end colour of the pellet in the login motion.

tokens.name: suit
tokens.usage: The umber suit of the recurring faceless man.

tokens.name: suit-shade
tokens.usage: Sleeves and shaded planes of the suit.

tokens.name: lamp-off
tokens.usage: Stage lamp body and unlit face; the rigging bar.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top right. Never larger, never bold.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Skill names in lists and section rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: ایده را تا به تا باز کنید؛ هر تا کمی بیشتر.
styles.usage: The one practical sentence under the header.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Small line above the sentence; section labels; ink-muted on paper.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between kicker and sentence.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav plate side inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Nav plate bottom inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side margin for all text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; capsule height.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsule buttons (half of 44).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Skill cards.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: The floating nav plate.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Pellet, lamps, the 'دانه' action.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Nav plate only.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Primary capsule: a printed key, not a glow.

tokens.usage: Light cards: lifts them off the paper so they read as buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card-active
tokens.usage: The dark 'continue' card.
